thread:
Maya: kicking off a lightweight bring-up checklist for the new sfo-gpu-edge region. goal: validate connectivity, basic GPU throughput, autoscale and a cost smoke projection. quick sync?
Sahil: +1. can we scope this to a 60m warmup with single-model load and a synthetic chat workload?
Ingrid: sounds good. main risks: inter-region egress, peering ACLs, and burst queueing causing unexpected preemption.
Leo: i'll run a capacity probe that hits the GPU pools with 1k short requests (seq len 64) to exercise batching and KV cache warm paths.
Maya: plan outline: 1) infra sanity (nodes, pods, CNI) 2) net/peering tests 3) gpu perf smoke 4) autoscale + SLO gate checks 5) cost delta estimate. keep notes in this thread.
Sahil: infra sanity quick checks I ran earlier: `kubectl get nodes -o wide` shows 12 gpu nodes Ready, kubelet 1.28, driver 535.54, dcgm healthy. no taints besides gpu: present.
Ingrid: tagging network checks: ping/latency to control-plane, inter-AZ bandwidth, and cloud egress baseline. also verify BGP sessions to transit.
Leo: running the GPU probe now. command: ```python tools/gpu_probe.py --region sfo --workers 16 --requests 1000 --model llama-13b-v2``` will post results when done.
OpsBot: [deploy-bot] started job gpu-proof-sfo-2361234000, run id job-9a7b. logs: /deploys/job-9a7b/logs
Maya: for autoscale we need to verify both scale-up latency and cooldown behavior — target SLO: median scale-up <= 60s, no more than 1 spike of >2x baseline in first 15m.
Sahil: noted. also add a capped burst policy test to ensure we don't accidentally burst into dedicated pools — config snippet: ```route: { policy: "regional-preemptible", burst: 50 }```
Ingrid: network probe results: control-plane RTT 8-12ms, egress to us-west cloud storage 110ms under full test, sustained tcp throughput ~650Mbps between AZs (expected ~1Gbps), BGP flaps none. add checklist item: consider multi-path tuning for long-tail p99s.
Leo: gpu_probe summary: 1000 requests done. avg latency (token only) 54ms, p95 210ms, p99 420ms. batching effective at 1-2ms per extra token. observed ~3% dropped requests during a short node restart (kube drain during upgrade). attaching snippet: ```FAILED: 32/1000 transient grpc UNAVAILABLE during drain```
Maya: that's ok if caught by retry policies. we should validate client-side retry and server fallback to smaller model variant. add a canary route test for fallback.
Sahil: cost projection quick calc: baseline hosted egress + gpu-hours for 1h: GPU hours 12 nodes * 1h = 12 GPUh, estimated cost $X/hr -> approx $Y. but main variable is egress to s3 for artifacts; we saw 120ms latency -> potential increased token generation cost due to slower warms. recommend simulating 10k token/day estimate for perf-adjusted cost.
Ingrid: SLO gate check: create pass/fail: (1) node readiness >= 99% during test, (2) p95 latency < 300ms, (3) scale-up <= 60s, (4) no persistent networking errors >0.5%. Current run: nodes 100% (aside from one drain window), p95 210ms pass, scale-up measured 48s pass, network errors 3.2% (fail).
Leo: network errors concentrated during the kube drain window where some requests retried and hit timeouts. if we re-run without an upgrade window, network errors drop <0.5%.
Maya: decision: mark region as "provisioned - needs follow up". follow ups: (a) schedule window-free repeat run (Sahil), (b) tighten burst policy and validate route fallbacks (Ingrid), (c) cost simulation with 10k/100k token/day (Leo). once green, perform readiness review with infra+product.
Sahil: i'll re-run the probe Wed 06:00 UTC, no drains, and post raw logs here.
Ingrid: i'll apply a temporary egress QoS and bump inter-AZ MTU settings to test p99 impact, then re-run net probe.
Leo: will run cost sims and create a short dashboard panel (tokens -> gpu-hours -> egress).
Maya: thanks team. add retrospective note for the readiness review: include a small runbook for "graceful kube drain" to avoid client-side spikes during bring-up.
OpsBot: [job-complete] gpu-proof-sfo-2361234000 job-9a7b completed. artifacts: /deploys/job-9a7b/artifacts/summary.json
Maya: saved. we'll reconvene after the Wed rerun and close the provisioning checklist if follow-ups are green. :thumbsup:
